output.one_line: Board approved capex of up to Rs 83 Cr to raise capacity at the Avadi cold-rolled steel strip plant, funded from internal accruals.
output.so_what: Modest spend, about 0.3% of TTM revenue of Rs 25,561 Cr and funded internally. The filing says the capacity gain cannot yet be quantified, so the payoff is unclear.
questions: How much incremental tonnage or revenue does the Avadi CRSS expansion add, and what is the expected payback?
What demand is driving the expansion, and how will the product mix affect margins once the new capacity runs?
